title: 第十七章 诡异对抗陆羽插手第十八章 本体降临
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
房间之内的诡异力量，一个有些外强中干，一个却是强大而又源源不断。
那个外强中干的诡异气息源头，应该就是那个驭诡者队长的了。
而那个真的强大，扩散出去的诡异气息，近乎笼罩了整栋居民楼，使得整栋楼的住户，全都陷入噩梦的诡异气息源头，应该就是他白天看到的那只白衣诡异了。
此时此刻，整栋大楼之内的所有人，都在散发着一丝丝的恐惧、绝望，等等负面精神力量，不断融入周围的诡异力量之中，增强着那股诡异力量。
感受到这种情况，陆羽不由微微皱眉，他感觉这什么国家组织，也太不专业了吧？
既然知道这里发生了诡异事件，怎么也要让这栋楼里的住户，暂时搬迁出去啊。
现在这样，不是在壮大那诡异的力量吗？
而且，一旦出现什么不测，还有可能造成人员伤亡。
不过此时，倒也不是想这些的时候了。
还是先想想，怎么对付里面的那只诡异吧。
嗯...
陆羽微微沉吟，恐惧之力便是再次流转而出，迅速的向着周围蔓延开来。
瞬间，那诡异的阴森力量，便是被陆羽的恐惧之力排斥开来，乃至是被其吞噬。
“嗯...”
感应到周围力量之间的变化，陆羽微微一愣，这诡异这么弱的吗？不至于吧？
不过虽然疑惑，但是陆羽恐惧之力的扩散，却是并没有停下。
随着陆羽恐惧之力的扩散，那只诡异的诡异力量，开始被慢慢的排斥开来，甚至被陆羽的恐惧之力吞噬。
渐渐的，陆羽的恐惧之力，代替了那只诡异的力量，笼罩了整座大楼。
此时的陆羽方才发现，他的力量在这一片地方，似乎能够发挥出大部分力量来，足足能够笼罩方圆九米的范围。
而他们所在的这座居民楼，也才不过六层，十多米而已。

陆羽只是将自身力量，更多的向着下方蔓延，便足以笼罩整栋居民楼，影响数十户居民了。
恐惧之力进入众人梦境，瞬间驱散了诡异的力量。
嗯...
一股股比起刚才更为浓郁，蕴含恐惧情绪的精神力量，开始从众人身上散发而出，融入陆羽的恐惧之力。
“呜~！”
不由的，陆羽微微眯起双眼，发出一声舒服的呻吟。
这可是整栋楼，几十户，一两百人啊。
一两百人的恐惧力量，突然融入陆羽的恐惧之力，立即便是让它飞速膨胀起来。
若非陆羽突然惊醒过来，恐怕恐惧之力，就要扩散到更远的范围了。
“呼~！”
深深吸气，陆羽压下了心中的诸般念头，开始收回扩散的恐惧之力。
随着大量的恐惧之力回流，不断的涌入梦境世界，其中所积存的绚烂光雾，便宛如夏日冰雪一般，被快速的消融转化，彻底化为了梦境世界的力量。
渐渐的，恐惧之力笼罩的范围越来越小，直至只笼罩了六零二房间。
或许是因为失去了诡异力量，以及恐惧之力的影响，整栋大楼之内，响起了此起彼伏的惊叫之声。
显然，有着许多人，都被自己做的噩梦给惊醒了。
content_en:
Among the strange forces in the room, one is a little strong but the other is powerful and endless.
The source of the strange aura of the powerful but powerful person should be the Captain of the Terror Controller.
And the source of that really powerful, strange aura that spread out and nearly enveloped the entire residential building, causing all the residents in the building to fall into nightmares, was probably the white-clothed weirdo he saw during the day.
At this moment, everyone in the entire building is exuding a trace of fear, despair, and other negative spiritual forces, which are constantly integrated into the surrounding strange power, strengthening that strange power.
Feeling this situation, Lu Yu couldn't help but frown slightly. He felt that this national organization was too unprofessional, right?
Now that we know something strange happened here, why should we ask the residents in this building to move out temporarily?
Now, isn't it strengthening that weird power?
Moreover, if something unexpected happens, it may cause casualties.
But at this moment, it's not the time to think about this.
Let's think about how to deal with the weird one inside.
Well...
Lu Yu pondered slightly, and the power of fear flowed out again, quickly spreading to the surroundings.
In an instant, the strange and gloomy power was repelled by Lu Yu's power of fear, and was even swallowed up by it.
"Well..."
Sensing the changes in the surrounding power, Lu Yu was slightly startled. Is this weird so weak? Isn't it?
However, despite his doubts, the spread of Lu Yu's fear did not stop.
As Lu Yu's power of fear spread, that strange and strange power began to be slowly pushed away, and was even swallowed up by Lu Yu's power of fear.
Gradually, Lu Yu's power of fear replaced the strange power and enveloped the entire building.
At this time, Lu Yu discovered that his power seemed to be able to exert most of its power in this area, covering a nine-meter radius.
And the residential building they were in was only six floors, just over ten meters tall.
Lu Yu just spread more of his power downwards, which was enough to cover the entire residential building and affect dozens of residents.
The power of fear entered everyone's dreams and instantly dispelled the strange power.
Well...
A stream of spiritual power that was more intense than before and contained fear began to emanate from everyone and merged into Lu Yu's power of fear.
"Woo~!"
Involuntarily, Lu Yu narrowed his eyes slightly and let out a comfortable groan.
This is an entire building, with dozens of households and one or two hundred people.
The fear power of one or two hundred people suddenly merged with Lu Yu's fear power, causing it to expand rapidly.
If Lu Yu hadn't suddenly woken up, the power of fear would have spread further.
"Huh~!"
Taking a deep breath, Lu Yu suppressed all the thoughts in his heart and began to withdraw the spreading power of fear.
As a large amount of fear power flows back into the dream world, the brilliant light mist accumulated in it is like summer ice and snow, rapidly melting and transformed, completely turning into the power of the dream world.
Gradually, the area covered by the power of fear became smaller and smaller, until it only covered Room 602.
Perhaps because of the loss of strange power and the influence of the power of fear, screams could be heard one after another throughout the building.
Obviously, many people were awakened by their nightmares.
